decisions.reason: Its move from a website mention in 2023 to the home page in 2024 suggests encouraging uptake and strong strategic fit with the firm's mental health and community-support capabilities, so the option is worth retaining.

Senior-living counseling is closely tied to the firm's core eldercare business and likely inexpensive to maintain while generating referrals, so management would keep this low-cost, high-fit option open.
The retail shop gained prominence by 2024 and leverages existing sheltered-workshop production and social mission, making it a reasonable adjacent activity to continue despite some retail risk.

Meal delivery for seniors fits the firm's care portfolio but is newer and more operationally demanding, so uncertainty remains higher; still, in an expanding firm it is worth keeping for another year as an option rather than abandoning now.
